# sauth_claim_object (Resource)

The claim_object records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_id` (String) claim id
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references

### Optional

- `access` (Number) access mask that narrows the claim, the claim mask when absent
- `inherits` (Boolean) whether the binding cascades down the object tree
- `object_id` (String) object id, sent together with object_type
- `object_type` (String) schema qualified object type, sent together with object_id
- `reason` (String) reason stored on the binding
- `scope` (Dynamic) capability payload, required when no object is named
